Phasing Quirk.name: Phasing Quirk
Phasing Quirk.description:
👻 You turn intangible, along with whatever you wear and carry.

🌱 At the start you phase for as long as you can hold a breath: blows, blades and bullets pass through you, and you walk through about a meter of wall.
📈 With training: peeks through walls, counters from inside a guard, rubble searched from within, people carried through walls, reeling foes, a runaway truck phased past.
⚠️ While phased you cannot see, hear or breathe, and you sink through floors if you lose focus.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Sensory Overload, as sight and sound slam back when you turn solid.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Mirio Togata (Permeation).

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Mobility +10, Combat Tactics +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Hollow Guard, Wallwalk
Phasing Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user turns intangible with all they wear and carry. New adult user: phased for a held breath, through about a meter of wall; blows, blades, bullets and blasts pass through. Partial phasing and phasing others need techniques. Limits: fully phased, the user cannot see, hear or breathe and moves from memory; losing focus sinks them through the floor. They must turn solid to strike or grab, and enemies wait for that instant; the Quirk shoves them out of matter before they solidify; mind-affecting Quirks still reach them. Quirk Strain: light: letting an attack through; moderate: wall walk, peek, counter, rubble search; heavy: carrying someone, running through enemies; severe: signature strike, phasing a vehicle or slab. Type: Transformation. Law: phasing into a home or vault without a license or warrant is burglary; police suspect registered phasers first after locked-room break-ins. Look: skin ripples, outline faintly translucent.
